Managed Device Attestation listing copy vs MDM engineering — two different jobs

Teams assume MDM device attestation support covers storefront language. Fleet attestation certificate chains and App Store Connect actually separate runtime device-trust verification from product-page copy:

  • Managed Device Attestation on the device — when MDM or DDM issues attestation requests that return cryptographic proof an enrolled device is genuine Apple hardware with untampered secure enclave — device attestation certificates, hardware-backed keys, and attestation status responses. System MDM attestation flows — outside AppLocale scope.
  • MDM console and server flows — IT admins query attestation status, review attested-device trust dashboards, block non-attested devices from access, and integrate attestation results with conditional access from Jamf, Intune, Kandji, Mosyle, or your app's attestation UI. Certificate chain validation and server work belong in engineering — not listing rewrite.
  • Managed Device Attestation marketing on the product page — description paragraphs, subtitle positioning, keywords, promotional text, and screenshot overlays that tell buyers your app verifies device attestation certificates, surfaces attestation status, or enforces attested-device trust before granting access. Connect text fields — this page.

  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, and screenshot caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Managed Device Attestation claims in the app.

An app that verifies Managed Device Attestation on fleets and a localized China listing are both valuable — neither replaces the other. Inventory lists device facts; attestation cryptographically proves device integrity. See Device Inventory listing when serial number lookup and asset audit are your lead — not hardware attestation.

Managed Device Attestation vocabulary — what translates differently in zh-Hans

MDM device-attestation marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general localization guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate fleet device-trust — not a literal paste of US marketing:

托管设备证明 / 设备证明 (Managed Device Attestation / Device Attestation)

Enterprise MDM marketing uses 托管设备证明 and 设备证明 when describing MDM cryptographic attestation that enrolled fleet devices are genuine Apple hardware with untampered secure enclave. Apple documentation and Chinese IT admin materials also use Managed Device Attestation and Device Attestation in English on technical mockups. AppLocale picks phrasing buyers recognize on each screenshot — an attestation status dashboard needs 托管设备证明-friendly headlines; a benefit line may use 设备证明 when accurate to your English source.

设备认证 (device authentication via attestation)

US pages say "Device authentication" or "Verify device trust before access." China storefront copy often uses 设备认证 when gallery frames show conditional-access gates that require attestation status before granting corporate resources — distinct from Enterprise SSO org sign-in vocabulary unless your English source genuinely shows both on separate frames.

硬件证明 (hardware attestation)

When MDM attestation workflows prove secure enclave and hardware integrity, zh-Hans enterprise docs use 硬件证明. Use when your gallery shows hardware attestation panels, secure-enclave trust badges, or "Hardware attestation" overlays — distinct from 设备清单 hardware inventory listing vocabulary.

密钥证明 (key attestation)

Hardware-backed key attestation and key attestation status map to 密钥证明 on admin-console frames — not Certificate Management SCEP identity cert enrollment alone. Use when your English source markets key attestation workflows or hardware-backed keys panels.

设备证明状态 (attestation status)

Attestation status queries and attestation status dashboards map to 设备证明状态 — the runtime state IT admins read before trusting a device. Use when your frame shows attestation status columns, pass/fail attestation gates, or "Attestation status" badges.

Device attestation certificates and hardware-backed keys

Technical mockups may keep English field labels for device attestation certificates and hardware-backed keys — with brief native benefit lines where Chinese IT admins expect them. Do not conflate device attestation certificates with SCEP identity certificates unless your English source markets both on separate frames.
